buyingOrder.why: Cheap bulletproof car that makes early contact missions and heist setups far safer and quicker.
Low entry cost, runs in the background and sells with one bike, so it suits brand-new solo players.
Security Contracts, Payphone Hits and the Dr. Dre contract give steady solo work plus a passive safe.
Cayo Perico was trimmed in July 2026 but is still a strong solo run once per cooldown.
Add it to the Kosatka for quick Cayo prep and a helicopter that spawns right beside you.
Reliable semi-passive earner once upgraded, and it feeds extra stock into a Nightclub later.
Buy once you own feeder businesses; its warehouse turns them into hands-off passive income.
Pricey, but cuts travel time on every mission, resupply and sale across the map.
Short, repeatable robbery contracts with fast payback make it a solid mid-game upgrade.
Weekly robberies pay well and the tow truck adds a bit of passive income on top.

items.why: Flying bike with boost and homing missiles; the go-to choice for grinding missions and sell runs.
Stops nearly all gunfire, making AI-heavy missions and heist setups easy, though explosives still kill it.
Small, quick chopper that spawns next to you, ideal for Cayo scoping and fast trips.
Fast car that dives underwater, boosts and fires missiles, so it handles almost any job.
Armed, nimble and free to call in as a CEO, making it a cheap all-purpose air option.
With the HSW upgrade it tops the speed charts, great for races and time trials.
Stays off enemy radar and carries heavy weapons, handy for combat-heavy missions and griefers.
Tough, very fast in a straight line and packs missiles, a fun alternative to flying.
Accurate, hard-hitting and versatile; the backbone of most recommended loadouts.
Highest sniper damage, and explosive rounds let it take out vehicles from range.
Lock-on rockets make short work of cars, helicopters and flying bikes.
Big magazine and strong damage for clearing large groups of enemies in missions.
Fully automatic pistol that shreds enemies when shooting from a car or bike.
Huge damage up close, ideal for tight interiors during heists and raids.
Remote-detonated charges for destroying targets, vehicles and blocked paths.
Several solo income streams in one property, plus a safe that fills on its own.
Cheap to run, solo-friendly, and every sale uses a single easy delivery bike.
Unlocks Cayo Perico; still worth running once per cooldown after the 2026 payout cuts.
Collects goods from your other businesses with no supply runs needed.
Dependable gunrunning income once upgraded, and it boosts Nightclub stock.
Repeatable robbery contracts and customer car deliveries pay off the price fast.
Big weekly robbery jobs plus some tow-truck passive income for regular players.

items.role: Best active grind for the price
items.why: Air cargo sourcing pays very well for its cost if you have a fast aircraft to haul it.
Still the top solo heist even after the July 2026 cuts; run it once per cooldown.
Big take and flexible approaches; the boosted first weekly finish makes it worth doing every week.
Newest heist with a large first-sale-of-the-week bonus, though it needs a Mansion and Art Studio.
Solo-friendly contract with a large one-off payout, best repeated when weekly bonuses hit.
The highest-paying Auto Shop job, short setups and fully doable alone.
Kept its base pay in 2026 and gets a weekly first-completion boost; great with friends.
The richest Doomsday act; a worthwhile weekly run for crews with a Facility.
Needs no business to start, can be done alone and is a good earner for new players.
Run businesses from anywhere, source Nightclub goods and upgrade the Oppressor Mk II.
Required for the Doomsday Heist and its weekly bonus runs; also holds the Orbital Cannon.
Needed for the Diamond Casino Heist and can host a Master Control Terminal for businesses.
Unlocks weapon Mk II upgrades and armored vehicle workshop mods that many players rely on.
A huge mobile base with a vehicle workshop; a luxury rather than a money maker.
Quick Agency contracts that pay solidly and also level up the Agency safe.
Short assassination job with a big bonus for meeting the target conditions.
Take out four targets for quick cash with a short cooldown between runs.
Collect a few hidden packages; simple, fast money that suits fast vehicles.
Repeatable air cargo runs that turn the Hangar into one of the best active earners.
